sentences.zh: 好吧，他们的首要目标是不犯任何可能被对手利用的错误。

sentences.zh: 第二个目标是针对对方阵营的领跑者进行抨击。

sentences.en: I want to answer the question, but I want to actually give an introduction to myself a little bit, because I recognize a lot of Americans don't know who either one of us are.
sentences.zh: 我想回答这个问题，但我实际上想先做一个自我介绍，因为我知道很多美国人并不了解我们俩是谁。

sentences.en: He opened with his biography.
sentences.zh: 他以自己的生平作为开场。

sentences.en: My mother required food assistance for periods of her life.
sentences.zh: 我母亲在生活中的某些时期需要食品援助。

sentences.en: He sounded more folksy.
sentences.zh: 他听起来更接地气。

sentences.en: And he answered the question in a way that Walls didn't.
sentences.zh: 而且他以沃尔兹没有做到的方式回答了问题。

sentences.en: It is up to Israel what they think they need to do to keep their country safe.

sentences.en: Well, to that point.

sentences.en: The economy is a top concern for voters.
sentences.zh: 经济是选民最关心的问题。

sentences.zh: 对我来说，真正引起关注的第一个议题就是经济问题。

sentences.en: And Vance kind of comes out of the gate and really just does this thing that Trump failed to do in the debate with Harris, which is, you know,
sentences.zh: 万斯一上来就做到了特朗普在与哈里斯辩论时没能做到的事，那就是，你知道，

sentences.en: put his finger on this idea that the working class had been shafted by the political class in the United States.
sentences.zh: 指出了工人阶级被美国政治阶层出卖这一观点。

sentences.en: Right now, Donald Trump's economic plan is not just a plan, but it's also a record.
sentences.zh: 目前，唐纳德·特朗普的经济计划不仅仅是一个计划，它也是一份政绩。

sentences.en: A lot of those same economists.
sentences.zh: 许多同样的经济学家。

sentences.en: So Vance lays out a fairly compelling case about how all the experts that the government had relied on over the years were wrong about international trade.
sentences.zh: 所以万斯提出了一个相当有说服力的论点，即政府多年来依赖的所有专家在国际贸易问题上都错了。

sentences.en: But those same experts for 40 years said that if we shipped our manufacturing base off to China, we'd get cheaper goods.
sentences.zh: 但这些同样的专家在40年里一直说，如果我们把制造业基地转移到中国，我们就能得到更便宜的商品。

sentences.en: They lied about that.
sentences.zh: 他们在这一点上撒了谎。

sentences.en: They said if we shipped our industrial base off to other countries, to Mexico and elsewhere, it would make the middle class stronger.
sentences.zh: 他们说如果我们把工业基地转移到其他国家，比如墨西哥和其他地方，会让中产阶级更强大。

sentences.en: They were wrong about that.
sentences.zh: 他们在这一点上错了。

sentences.en: They were wrong about manufacturing and about engaging with Mexico and China.
sentences.zh: 他们在制造业以及与墨西哥和中国的接触问题上都错了。

sentences.en: And Vance talked about how that hurt the middle class in small towns like where he grew up.
sentences.zh: 万斯谈到了这如何伤害了他成长的那种小城镇的中产阶级。

sentences.en: In a generation, Donald Trump had the wisdom and the courage to say to that bipartisan consensus, we're not doing it anymore.
sentences.zh: 在这一代人中，唐纳德·特朗普有智慧和勇气对那种两党共识说，我们不再这样做了。

sentences.en: We're bringing American manufacturing back.
sentences.zh: 我们要把美国制造业带回来。

sentences.en: We're unleashing American energy.
sentences.zh: 我们要释放美国的能源。

sentences.en: We're going to make more of our own stuff.
sentences.zh: 我们要制造更多我们自己的产品。

sentences.en: And this isn't just an...
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是一个……

sentences.en: And Vance probably had his strongest moment of the debate in this discussion.
sentences.zh: 万斯在这次讨论中可能表现出了他辩论中最强的一面。

sentences.en: And he did a compelling job of explaining Trump's vision in a way that really sanded the hard edges off of Trumpism in general.
sentences.zh: 他出色地解释了特朗普的愿景，以一种真正磨平了特朗普主义尖锐棱角的方式。

sentences.en: This has to stop.
sentences.zh: 这种情况必须停止。

sentences.en: And we're not going to stop it by listening to experts.
sentences.zh: 我们不能通过听从专家来阻止它。

sentences.en: We're going to stop it by listening to common sense wisdom, which is what Donald Trump governed on.
sentences.zh: 我们要通过听从常识智慧来阻止它，而这正是唐纳德·特朗普执政的基础。

sentences.en: Senator, you're talking about Governor Walz.
sentences.zh: 参议员，您在谈论沃尔兹州长。

sentences.en: Can you address that?
sentences.zh: 您能回应一下吗？

sentences.en: And how did Walz respond to that?
sentences.zh: 沃尔兹是怎么回应的？

sentences.en: If you're listening tonight and you want billionaires to get tax cuts, you heard what the numbers were.
sentences.zh: 如果你今晚在听，并且希望亿万富翁获得减税，你已经听到了那些数字。

sentences.en: Look, I'm a union guy on this.
sentences.zh: 听着，我是个工会成员。

sentences.en: You know, he gave the standard response to Trump's economic plan from the Democrats give.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他给出了民主党对特朗普经济计划的标准回应。

sentences.en: They said that he would give tax cuts to billionaires.
sentences.zh: 他们说他会给亿万富翁减税。

sentences.en: Donald Trump was the guy who created the largest trade deficit in American history with China.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普是那个创造了美国历史上对华最大贸易逆差的人。

sentences.en: And he talked about Trump losing a trade war with China when he was president.
sentences.zh: 他还谈到了特朗普在担任总统时输掉了一场贸易战。

sentences.en: I'm not a guy who wanted to ship things overseas, but I understand.
sentences.zh: 我不是那种想把东西运往海外的人，但我理解。

sentences.en: He didn't really engage that much in Vance's argument that the experts led us down this path.
sentences.zh: 他并没有真正深入参与万斯关于“专家把我们带入歧途”的论点。

sentences.en: But he tried to make an argument against Trump's economic policies in general.
sentences.zh: 但他试图对特朗普的整体经济政策提出反对意见。

sentences.en: And he kind of was struggling.
sentences.zh: 他表现得有些吃力。

sentences.en: I mean, he doesn't have a great case to make because inflation is high and housing prices have risen.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他没有很好的理由，因为通货膨胀很高，房价也上涨了。

sentences.en: And, you know, the economy is generally a weak point for Democrats.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，经济通常是民主党的弱点。

sentences.en: It's a weak point, but it's one where they're getting better.
sentences.zh: 这是一个弱点，但他们正在改善。

sentences.en: But Walls did not make a crisp case on their behalf here.
sentences.zh: 但沃尔兹在这里并没有代表他们做出清晰有力的辩护。

sentences.en: So Vance really looked on stage like he just was kind of breezing along.
sentences.zh: 万斯在台上看起来确实表现得很轻松。

sentences.en: And, you know, he was delivering these arguments that were really the Republicans' best issues.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，他提出的那些论点确实是共和党最核心的议题。

sentences.en: He was doing them well.
sentences.zh: 他表现得很好。

sentences.en: And, you know, just generally he was owning the stage.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，总的来说他掌控了全场。

sentences.en: Walls wasn't really breaking through at all.
sentences.zh: 沃尔兹几乎完全没能突破他的防线。

sentences.en: Well, until you got to now to the issue of reproductive rights, the issue of abortion, which you and I were watching this together, Reed.
sentences.zh: 嗯，直到谈到生殖权利，也就是堕胎问题时，里德，你和我当时都在看。

sentences.en: It was about at the 44 minute mark.
sentences.zh: 那大约是在第44分钟的时候。

sentences.en: 44 minutes, almost exactly midway through was when the first question about abortion came up.
sentences.zh: 44分钟，几乎正好是辩论进行到一半时，第一个关于堕胎的问题出现了。

sentences.en: The bill says, but look, this this issue is what's on everyone's mind.
sentences.zh: 法案上是这么写的，但你看，这个问题才是每个人心头所想。

sentences.en: This is an issue that the Harris campaign wants injected into the bloodstream of every conversation.
sentences.zh: 这是哈里斯竞选团队希望注入每一场对话中的议题。

sentences.en: Donald Trump put this all into motion.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普启动了这一切。

sentences.en: He brags about how great it was that he put the judges in and overturned Roe versus Wade.
sentences.zh: 他吹嘘自己任命了大法官并推翻了“罗诉韦德案”，以此为荣。

sentences.en: 52 years of personal autonomy.
sentences.zh: 52年的个人自主权。

sentences.en: And Walls did quite well here.
sentences.zh: 沃尔兹在这里表现得相当不错。

sentences.en: The fact of the matter is, how can we as a nation say that your life and your rights, as basic as the right to control your own body, is determined on geography?
sentences.zh: 事实是，我们作为一个国家，怎么能说你的生命和权利——比如控制自己身体的基本权利——竟然取决于你住在哪里？

sentences.en: He talked about how the Trump argument that this is an issue left for the states means that human rights are different depending on what state you live in.
sentences.zh: 他谈到特朗普的论点，即这个问题应留给各州决定，这意味着人权会因你居住的州而异。

sentences.en: There's a young woman named Amber Thurman.
sentences.zh: 有一位年轻女性叫安珀·瑟曼。

sentences.en: She happened to be in Georgia, a restrictive state.
sentences.zh: 她恰好在佐治亚州，一个限制性法律的州。

sentences.en: Because of that, she had to travel a long distance to North Carolina to try and get her care.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，她不得不长途跋涉去北卡罗来纳州寻求医疗救助。

sentences.en: Amber Thurman died.
sentences.zh: 安珀·瑟曼去世了。

sentences.en: He talked about women who have died or become gravely ill because they didn't have access to health care that had been available before the Supreme Court overturned Roe versus Wade.
sentences.zh: 他谈到了那些因无法获得最高法院推翻“罗诉韦德案”前本可获得的医疗服务而死亡或病危的女性。

sentences.en: And he made this case that health care decisions are best left to women and the doctors that treat them.
sentences.zh: 他提出了一个观点，即医疗决策最好留给女性和她们的医生来做。

sentences.en: What about Vance?
sentences.zh: 万斯呢？

sentences.en: What about his response?
sentences.zh: 他的回应是什么？

sentences.en: Senator?
sentences.zh: 参议员？

sentences.en: May I respond to that?
sentences.zh: 我可以回应一下吗？

sentences.en: First of all, Governor, I agree with you.
sentences.zh: 首先，州长，我同意你的看法。

sentences.en: Amber Thurman should still be alive.
sentences.zh: 安珀·瑟曼本应还活着的。

sentences.en: And there are a lot of people who should still be alive.
sentences.zh: 还有很多人本应还活着的。

sentences.en: And I certainly wish that she was.
sentences.zh: 我当然希望她还活着。

sentences.en: Vance gave what was probably the most effective response available to him, given his and Trump's positions on abortion.
sentences.zh: 考虑到他和特朗普在堕胎问题上的立场，万斯给出了他所能给出的最有效的回应。

sentences.en: That's why Donald Trump and I are committed to pursuing pro-family policies, making child care more accessible, making fertility...
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么唐纳德·特朗普和我致力于推行亲家庭政策，让托儿服务更普及，让生育……

sentences.en: He talked about giving women options to continue pregnancies and ways to help the Republicans be pro-family.
sentences.zh: 他谈到为女性提供继续妊娠的选择，以及帮助共和党实现亲家庭目标的途径。

sentences.en: I want us to make it easier for moms to afford to have babies.
sentences.zh: 我希望让妈妈们更容易负担得起生孩子。

sentences.en: I want it to make it easier for young families to afford a home so they can afford a place to raise that family.
sentences.zh: 我希望让年轻家庭更容易负担得起住房，这样他们就有地方抚养家庭。

sentences.en: And I think there's so much that we can do...
sentences.zh: 我认为我们能做的事情还有很多……

sentences.en: Which is not exactly in their strong suit.
sentences.zh: 这可不是他们的强项。

sentences.en: And Reid, what did you make of Vance's response, though?
sentences.zh: 里德，你觉得万斯的回应怎么样？

sentences.en: I mean, it felt like a bit of a sleight of hand that he was doing, kind of like he was performing a magic trick.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他刚才的表现有点像是在玩障眼法，就像在变魔术一样。

sentences.en: He was saying, on the one hand, I kind of feel for women on this issue, but I really support IVF.
sentences.zh: 他一方面说，在这个问题上我挺同情女性的，但另一方面我又确实支持试管婴儿（IVF）。

sentences.en: You know, he was kind of doing this doublespeak in a way.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他某种程度上是在说一套做一套。

sentences.en: Well, and he was trying to explain Donald Trump's position more than he was his own position.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他是在试图解释唐纳德·特朗普的立场，而不是他自己的立场。

sentences.en: He said it is a matter left for the states to decide.
sentences.zh: 他说这是一个留给各州决定的问题。

sentences.en: He said the proper way to handle this...
sentences.zh: 他说处理这个问题的正确方式是……

sentences.en: As messy as democracy sometimes is, is to let voters make these decisions.
sentences.zh: 尽管民主有时很混乱，但还是要让选民自己做决定。

sentences.en: Is to let voters make these decisions for themselves and let the states set their own abortion policy.
sentences.zh: 就是让选民自己做决定，让各州制定自己的堕胎政策。

sentences.en: We can be a big and diverse country where we respect people's freedom of conscience and make the country more pro-baby and pro-family, but please...
sentences.zh: 我们可以成为一个伟大而多元的国家，尊重人们的良心自由，让国家变得更支持生育和家庭，但是请……

sentences.en: And it was an exchange that Walls really did not let him get away with.
sentences.zh: 这是一场沃尔兹确实没有让他轻易过关的交锋。

sentences.en: These are women's decisions to make about their health care decisions and the physicians who know best when they need to do this.
sentences.zh: 这些是女性关于她们医疗保健的决定，而最了解情况的医生知道何时需要采取行动。

sentences.en: Trying to destroy...
sentences.zh: 试图摧毁……

sentences.en: And Vance, for the first 45 minutes of the debate, had been in command of the event.
sentences.zh: 在辩论的前45分钟里，万斯一直掌控着局面。

sentences.en: And once this discussion shifted to abortion, it was Vance who struggled to explain the policies of his ticket and Walls who was on offense.
sentences.zh: 但一旦讨论转向堕胎，万斯在解释其竞选纲领时就显得吃力，而沃尔兹则转为进攻。

sentences.en: It marked a shift in this debate that we saw play out over the second half.
sentences.zh: 这标志着辩论的转折点，我们在下半场看到了这一点。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wena Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是维娜·刘。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games, and I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏中的“Connections”游戏，我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog, and I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗，也喜欢试图捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖尔斯基，我每天负责创作“Spelling Bee”和“Letterboxd”游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫“联觉”的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你们刚才听到的人那样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games 立即开始游戏。

sentences.en: So, Reid, you said that the tide of the debate really changed with the abortion discussion right about midway.
sentences.zh: 那么，里德，你说辩论的风向在中间讨论堕胎时确实改变了。

sentences.en: Where did it go next?
sentences.zh: 接下来发生了什么？

sentences.en: What stood out to you in that second half?
sentences.zh: 下半场有什么让你印象深刻的地方？

sentences.en: Welcome back to the CBS News vice presidential debate.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到哥伦比亚广播公司新闻部的副总统辩论。

sentences.en: We want to turn now to America's gun violence epidemic.
sentences.zh: 我们现在转向美国的枪支暴力流行病问题。

sentences.en: You know, the first moment of the second half was a discussion about gun control and gun violence.
sentences.zh: 你知道，下半场的第一个议题是关于枪支管制和枪支暴力的讨论。

sentences.en: Governor, you have two minutes.
sentences.zh: 州长，你有两分钟时间。

sentences.en: Well, I think all the parents watching tonight, this is your biggest nightmare.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想今晚观看节目的所有家长，这都是你们最大的噩梦。

sentences.en: Look, I got a 17-year-old, and he witnessed a shooting at a community center playing volleyball.
sentences.zh: 看，我有个17岁的儿子，他在社区中心打排球时目睹了一场枪击事件。

sentences.en: Those things don't leave you.
sentences.zh: 那些经历是挥之不去的。

sentences.en: And Walls introduced this story that he's told a couple times about his 17-year-old son witnessing a shooting while playing volleyball in a community center in Minnesota.
sentences.zh: 沃尔兹讲了这个他讲过几次的故事，关于他17岁的儿子在明尼苏达州的一个社区中心打排球时目睹了枪击事件。

sentences.en: It was a pretty raw story.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常令人心碎的故事。

sentences.en: And as he said this, you could see Vance flinch a little bit.
sentences.zh: 当他说这些话时，你可以看到万斯畏缩了一下。

sentences.en: And for all the preparations and the practice, Vance had not prepared himself for this moment.
sentences.zh: 尽管做了所有的准备和演练，万斯并没有为这一刻做好准备。

sentences.en: Senator?
sentences.zh: 参议员？

sentences.en: Tim, first of all, I didn't know that your 17-year-old witnessed a shooting.
sentences.zh: 蒂姆，首先，我不知道你17岁的儿子目睹了枪击事件。

sentences.en: I'm sorry about that, and I hope that you're doing okay.
sentences.zh: 对此我感到很遗憾，希望你们现在都好。

sentences.en: Christ have mercy.
sentences.zh: 上帝保佑。

sentences.en: It is awful.
sentences.zh: 这太可怕了。

sentences.en: And he said he didn't know that Gus Walls had witnessed a shooting.
sentences.zh: 他说他不知道格斯·沃尔兹目睹过枪击事件。

sentences.en: And it was a moment of humanity that we don't often see in these situations.
sentences.zh: 那是一个我们在这种场合很少见到的充满人性的时刻。

sentences.en: It was Vance as a father, not in the way where he talked about his own kids, to make a political point,
sentences.zh: 那是作为父亲的万斯，不是那种为了政治目的谈论自己孩子的万斯，

sentences.en: but a way you could see him having real empathy for Walls' son in a way that hadn't come across in any of the rest of the policy debates.
sentences.zh: 而是你能看出他真的对沃尔兹的儿子产生了共情，这种感觉在其他政策辩论中从未出现过。

sentences.en: It was a fascinating look at how Vance dealt with a real-life situation.
sentences.zh: 这是一个观察万斯如何处理现实生活情况的迷人视角。

sentences.en: But then...
sentences.zh: 但随后……

sentences.en: Let's turn now to the top contributor to inflation, the high cost of housing and rent.
sentences.zh: 现在让我们转向通胀的主要推手，即高昂的住房和租金成本。

sentences.en: There was a discussion about housing.
sentences.zh: 讨论转向了住房问题。

sentences.en: There was a discussion about federal lands.
sentences.zh: 讨论了联邦土地问题。

sentences.en: Houses in the same federal land.
sentences.zh: 联邦土地上的房屋。

sentences.en: There was sort of more about immigration.
sentences.zh: 还有更多关于移民的内容。

sentences.en: Blame immigrants for higher housing prices.
sentences.zh: 将高房价归咎于移民。

sentences.en: The discussion was much more policy-based.
sentences.zh: 讨论更多地基于政策。

sentences.en: And it got very in the weeds and wonky.
sentences.zh: 而且变得非常深入和专业。

sentences.en: Yeah, I was really surprised at just how much policy was there.
sentences.zh: 是的，我真的很惊讶竟然有这么多政策讨论。

sentences.en: It's like I felt like I hadn't heard it in a long time.
sentences.zh: 感觉好像我已经很久没听过这样的讨论了。

sentences.en: We're so used to Trump with his own kind of gravitational force.
sentences.zh: 我们太习惯特朗普那种自带的引力场了。

sentences.en: And those debates sound different.
sentences.zh: 那些辩论听起来完全不同。

sentences.en: This sounded like an old-school political debate where people talked about policy and, you know, were civil to one another.
sentences.zh: 这听起来像是一场老派的政治辩论，人们谈论政策，而且，你知道，彼此之间很有礼貌。

sentences.en: It was less about the personalities of the figures on stage than it was about what they would do in office.
sentences.zh: 这更多是关于他们上任后会做什么，而不是关于台上人物的个性。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, it struck me that Vance was very good at repackaging and repurposing Trump's message.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，令我印象深刻的是，万斯非常擅长重新包装和利用特朗普的信息。

sentences.en: I mean, he kind of put it through this, like, you know, civility normalization machine.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他把它放进了某种，你知道，文明规范化的机器里。

sentences.en: And it popped out and it sounded pretty good.
sentences.zh: 然后出来的时候听起来相当不错。

sentences.en: I mean,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，

sentences.en: Vance is very skilled at making Trump sound reasonable and making his ideas come across in a way that don't sound perhaps as scary or sharp-edged as Trump does when he sort of as a blunt force instrument delivers them as the only possible solution.
sentences.zh: 万斯非常擅长让特朗普听起来合理，并以一种不那么吓人或尖锐的方式传达他的想法，而不像特朗普那样，将其作为唯一的解决方案以钝器般的方式强加于人。

sentences.en: And anyone who says anything different is wrong and anti-American.
sentences.zh: 而且任何持不同意见的人都是错的，都是反美国的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: But he could only go so far.
sentences.zh: 但他能做的也仅限于此。

sentences.en: Let's talk about the state of democracy, the top issue for Americans after the economy and inflation.
sentences.zh: 让我们谈谈民主状况，这是继经济和通胀之后美国人最关心的问题。

sentences.en: So where did Vance hit up against the limits of being able to sell Trump's policies?
sentences.zh: 那么万斯在兜售特朗普政策时，在哪里碰到了极限？

sentences.en: In the same place that a lot of Republicans find themselves at odds with reality, and that's the 2020 election.
sentences.zh: 在许多共和党人发现自己与现实脱节的地方，那就是2020年大选。

sentences.en: Senator Vance, you have said you would not have certified the last presidential election.
sentences.zh: 万斯参议员，你说过你不会认证上次总统选举的结果。

sentences.en: Would you again seek to challenge this year's election results?
sentences.zh: 你今年还会寻求挑战选举结果吗？

sentences.en: He was asked if he would seek to challenge this year's presidential election results, even if every governor in America certifies them at the state level.
sentences.zh: 有人问他，即使美国每一位州长都在州一级认证了结果，他是否仍会寻求挑战今年的总统选举结果。

sentences.en: Look, what President Trump has said is that there were problems in 2020.
sentences.zh: 看，特朗普总统所说的是2020年存在问题。

sentences.en: And my own belief is that we should fight about those issues, debate those issues peacefully in the public square.
sentences.zh: 我个人的信念是，我们应该在公共广场上和平地争论这些问题，辩论这些问题。

sentences.en: And Vance tried to pivot.
sentences.zh: 万斯试图转移话题。

sentences.en: And it's Kamala Harris saying that rather than debate and persuade her fellow Americans, she'd like to censor people who engage in misinformation.
sentences.zh: 是卡玛拉·哈里斯说，与其辩论并说服她的美国同胞，她更愿意审查那些散布错误信息的人。

sentences.en: I think that is a much bigger threat to democracy than anything that we've seen in this country.
sentences.zh: 我认为这比我们在国内看到的任何事情都对民主构成了更大的威胁。

sentences.en: He didn't really answer the question.
sentences.zh: 他并没有真正回答这个问题。

sentences.en: He said censorship is a bigger threat to democracy than Donald Trump saying protesters should peacefully protest the election.
sentences.zh: 他说审查制度比唐纳德·特朗普呼吁抗议者和平抗议选举对民主的威胁更大。

sentences.en: Well, I've enjoyed tonight's debate, and I think there was a lot of commonality here.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我很享受今晚的辩论，我认为这里有很多共同点。

sentences.en: And I'm sympathetic to misspeaking on things, and I think I might have with the senator.
sentences.zh: 我对口误表示同情，我想我和参议员可能都有过。

sentences.en: Me too, man.
sentences.zh: 我也是，伙计。

sentences.en: There's one, though, that this one is troubling to me.
sentences.zh: 不过有一点，这一点让我感到不安。

sentences.en: And I say that because I think we need to tell the story.
sentences.zh: 我这么说是因为我认为我们需要讲出真相。

sentences.en: And Walls didn't buy this for a minute.
sentences.zh: 沃尔兹一分钟都没买账。

sentences.en: 140 police officers were beaten at the Capitol that day.
sentences.zh: 那天有140名警察在国会大厦遭到殴打。

sentences.en: He talked about January 6th protesters.
sentences.zh: 他谈到了1月6日的抗议者。

sentences.en: In Minnesota, a group gathered on the state Capitol grounds in St. Paul and said, we're marching to the governor's residence and there may be casualties.
sentences.zh: 在明尼苏达州，一群人在圣保罗的州议会大厦集会，说我们要游行到州长官邸，可能会有伤亡。

sentences.en: The only person there was my son and his dog who was rushed out crying by state police.
sentences.zh: 那里唯一的人就是我的儿子和他的狗，被州警匆忙带走时还在哭泣。

sentences.en: Not just in Washington, but coming after his home in St. Paul, Minnesota.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是在华盛顿，而是针对他在明尼苏达州圣保罗的家。

sentences.en: When Mike Pence made that decision to certify that election, that's why Mike Pence isn't on this stage.
sentences.zh: 当迈克·彭斯做出认证选举的决定时，这就是为什么迈克·彭斯今天没有站在这个舞台上。

sentences.en: He said at one point, if Mike Pence had not certified the election, he would still be Trump's running mate today.
sentences.zh: 他曾一度表示，如果迈克·彭斯没有认证选举，他今天仍会是特朗普的竞选搭档。

sentences.en: And then Walls asked the question that J.D.
sentences.zh: 然后沃尔兹问了一个J.D.

sentences.en: Vance is unable to answer.
sentences.zh: 万斯无法回答的问题。

sentences.en: I would just ask that.
sentences.zh: 我只想问那个。

sentences.en: Did he lose the 2020 election?
sentences.zh: 他输掉了2020年大选吗？

sentences.en: Which is, did Trump lose the 2020 election?
sentences.zh: 也就是，特朗普输掉了2020年大选吗？

sentences.en: Tim, I'm focused on the future.
sentences.zh: 蒂姆，我专注于未来。

sentences.en: Did Kamala Harris censor Americans from speaking their mind in the wake of 2020?
sentences.zh: 卡玛拉·哈里斯在2020年后是否审查了美国人表达想法的权利？

sentences.en: And Vance doesn't answer it.
sentences.zh: 万斯没有回答。

sentences.en: He says he's focused on the future.
sentences.zh: 他说他专注于未来。

sentences.en: And he tries to pivot back to asking, did Kamala Harris censor Americans from speaking their minds about COVID in 2020?
sentences.zh: 他试图转回问，卡玛拉·哈里斯是否在2020年审查了美国人关于新冠疫情的言论？

sentences.en: He totally dodges.
sentences.zh: 他完全回避了。

sentences.en: That is a damning non-answer.
sentences.zh: 这是一个令人谴责的非回答。

sentences.en: It's a damning non-answer for you to not talk about censorship.
sentences.zh: 你不谈论审查制度，这是一个令人谴责的非回答。

sentences.en: And Walls points that out to everyone watching, and he called it a damning non-answer.
sentences.zh: 沃尔兹向所有观众指出了这一点，并称其为令人谴责的非回答。

sentences.en: And Vance tried to save himself by saying it was damning for Walls not to talk about censorship.
sentences.zh: 万斯试图通过声称沃尔兹不谈审查制度是种谴责来为自己开脱。

sentences.en: But that wasn't what the question was about.
sentences.zh: 但那并不是问题的核心。

sentences.en: And frankly, it is less of a threat to democracy than the question of free and fair elections.
sentences.zh: 坦白说，这比起自由公正选举的问题，对民主的威胁要小得多。

sentences.en: But this whole exchange really illustrated the red lines that nobody in Trump's world can cross, which are, you can't say that Trump lost the election.
sentences.zh: 但整个交流过程确实展现了特朗普阵营中无人敢触碰的红线，那就是：你不能说特朗普输掉了选举。

sentences.en: You can't blame Trump for January 6th.
sentences.zh: 你不能把1月6日事件归咎于特朗普。

sentences.en: You can't say that he incited the riot.
sentences.zh: 你不能说他煽动了那场骚乱。

sentences.en: And so it was a very skilled moment from Walls, who didn't look particularly skilled for much of the night, to pose that question to Vance,
sentences.zh: 所以，沃尔兹在当晚大部分时间表现得并不怎么高明的情况下，能向万斯提出那个问题，确实是非常老练的一招，

sentences.en: knowing that it was one that Vance couldn't answer.
sentences.zh: 因为他知道万斯无法回答这个问题。

sentences.en: And that was the last big moment of the debate.
sentences.zh: 这也是那场辩论中最后一个重大的时刻。

sentences.en: And thank you both for participating in the only vice presidential debate of this election cycle.
sentences.zh: 感谢两位参加本届选举周期中唯一的一场副总统辩论。

sentences.en: And what did you make of that moment?
sentences.zh: 你对那一刻有什么看法？

sentences.en: You know, I think this is the moment that we'll remember from this debate.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我认为这将是这场辩论中我们最难忘的时刻。

sentences.en: Vance had spent, at this point, an hour and a half ably answering most of the questions that came across.
sentences.zh: 在那之前，万斯已经花了一个半小时，从容地回答了大部分提出的问题。

sentences.en: And the ones that were trickier, he sort of talked his way through.
sentences.zh: 对于那些棘手的问题，他也算是勉强应付过去了。

sentences.en: And then he got what might have been the easiest question of the night, who won the last election?
sentences.zh: 然后他遇到了当晚可能最简单的一个问题：谁赢得了上次选举？

sentences.en: And he's not able to answer it.
sentences.zh: 结果他却回答不上来。

sentences.en: You know, that idea that he is not saying everything that he knows, or hiding something, or altering his remarks to please someone else,
sentences.zh: 你知道，那种他没有说出实情、有所隐瞒，或者为了取悦他人而改变言辞的想法，

sentences.en: is a very dangerous proposition in politics, because it suggests that he's not leveling or being straight with people.
sentences.zh: 在政治上是一个非常危险的信号，因为它暗示他并没有对民众坦诚相待。

sentences.en: And if Vance has that stripped from him at this stage, that he can't be trusted on the basic question of democracy, it's a difficult thing for him to overcome on other issues.
sentences.zh: 如果万斯在现阶段被剥去了这种信任，即他在民主的基本问题上都不可信，那么他在其他议题上就很难克服这种障碍。

sentences.en: But does this have an effect electorally?
sentences.zh: 但这会在选举上产生影响吗？

sentences.en: I mean, are undecided voters actually watching a vice presidential debate?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，未决定的选民真的会看副总统辩论吗？

sentences.en: Probably not.
sentences.zh: 可能不会。

sentences.en: But that moment is, as we speak, being cut into ads that the Harris campaign will be showing to people as soon as Wednesday morning.
sentences.zh: 但就在我们谈话的同时，那一刻正在被剪辑成广告，哈里斯竞选团队最早会在周三早上向公众播放。

sentences.en: And even though the Harris campaign and Democrats have not pushed democracy to the forefront of their campaign,
sentences.zh: 尽管哈里斯竞选团队和民主党人并没有把民主问题放在竞选的最前沿，

sentences.en: just because voters tend to be more motivated by issues like health care and abortion,
sentences.zh: 仅仅是因为选民往往更容易被医疗保健和堕胎等议题所驱动，

sentences.en: the idea that you can't trust J.D.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，你不能相信万斯会告诉你真相这一观点，

sentences.en: Vance to tell you the truth, I think, is going to be one that they make central to the aftermath of this debate.
sentences.zh: 将会成为他们在这场辩论后重点强调的内容。

sentences.en: This strikes to his honesty and his truthfulness in a way that can be very damaging.
sentences.zh: 这直击他的诚实和诚信，可能会造成非常严重的损害。

sentences.en: And this debate, like the last one, likely won't produce any major shift in the polls that we see in the next couple weeks.
sentences.zh: 而且这场辩论和上一场一样，很可能不会在未来几周的民调中产生任何重大变化。

sentences.en: But you have to remember, this is an election on the margins.
sentences.zh: 但你必须记住，这是一场在边缘地带决胜的选举。

sentences.en: And we're really talking about, you know, a couple hundred thousand voters in the seven battleground states moving one way or the other.
sentences.zh: 我们真正讨论的是，在七个摇摆州里，那几十万选民的动向。

sentences.en: That will determine who the next president is.
sentences.zh: 那将决定谁是下一任总统。

sentences.en: You know, tens of millions of people will have watched this debate and 70 million people watched the last debate.
sentences.zh: 你知道，有数千万人观看了这场辩论，而上一场辩论有7000万人观看。

sentences.en: But these candidates to win the election need to talk to just a tiny slice of voters in just a few states.
sentences.zh: 但这些候选人要赢得选举，只需要说服少数几个州里的一小部分选民。

sentences.en: And those are the ones whose judgment will determine the future of the country.
sentences.zh: 而正是这些人的判断将决定国家的未来。

sentences.en: Reid, it's late.
sentences.zh: 里德，很晚了。

sentences.en: Reid, it's very late.
sentences.zh: 里德，真的太晚了。

sentences.en: Thank you for talking.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你的交谈。

sentences.en: I'm going to bed.
sentences.zh: 我要去睡觉了。

sentences.en: Good night.
sentences.zh: 晚安。

sentences.en: Good night.
sentences.zh: 晚安。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you should know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还应该知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, Iran fired about 180 ballistic missiles at Israel in what it called a retaliation for Israel's surprise assassination on Friday of Hassan Nasrallah,
sentences.zh: 周二，伊朗向以色列发射了约180枚弹道导弹，称这是为了报复以色列上周五突然暗杀哈桑·纳斯鲁拉，

sentences.en: the leader of Hezbollah, a group that is backed by Iran.
sentences.zh: 他是真主党的领导人，该组织由伊朗支持。

sentences.en: The killing of the longtime foe of Israel and the United States shocked the Middle East and was seen as a major victory for Israel.
sentences.zh: 这位以色列和美国长期敌人的遇害震惊了中东，并被视为以色列的一项重大胜利。

sentences.en: The missile attack sent millions of Israelis into bomb shelters, but appeared to inflict little damage.
sentences.zh: 导弹袭击迫使数百万以色列人进入防空洞，但似乎造成的损害很小。

sentences.en: Above all, the airstrikes upended the assumption among Israelis that the country's increasingly brazen approach toward Iran and its allies would deter Iran from attacking Israel.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，这次空袭颠覆了以色列人的假设，即该国对伊朗及其盟友日益大胆的态度会阻止伊朗攻击以色列。

sentences.en: Tens of thousands of unionized dock workers from Maine to Texas have gone on strike,
sentences.zh: 从缅因州到得克萨斯州，数以万计的码头工会工人举行了罢工，

sentences.en: stranding cargo at many of the country's busiest ports and potentially disrupting the American supply chain.
sentences.zh: 导致美国许多最繁忙港口的货物滞留，并可能扰乱美国的供应链。

sentences.en: The dock workers, whose contract expired on Monday, are demanding a 62 percent increase in pay, a number that port operators have so far refused to meet.
sentences.zh: 这些码头工人的合同已于周一到期，他们要求加薪62%，而港口运营商迄今拒绝满足这一数字。

sentences.en: Finally.
sentences.zh: 最后。

sentences.en: Mr. President, on behalf of the entire Biden family and the American people, happy 100th birthday.
sentences.zh: 总统先生，我谨代表整个拜登家族和美国人民，祝您100岁生日快乐。

sentences.en: Nineteen months after entering hospice, for what many feared would be his final days, former President Jimmy Carter has turned 100 years old, becoming the first U.S.
sentences.zh: 在前总统吉米·卡特进入临终关怀阶段19个月后，许多人曾担心那会是他最后的日子，但他现在已经100岁了，成为第一位达到这一里程碑的美国总统。

sentences.en: president to reach that milestone.
sentences.zh: 总统。

sentences.en: Jimmy, thank you for your friendship, your example, and for always finding new ways to remind us that we are all created in God's image.
sentences.zh: 吉米，感谢你的友谊、你的榜样，以及总是以新的方式提醒我们，我们都是按照上帝的形象创造的。

sentences.en: Happy birthday.
sentences.zh: 生日快乐。

sentences.en: To celebrate the occasion.
sentences.zh: 为了庆祝这个时刻。

sentences.en: You've had a heck of a life, and you're surrounded by people who love you.
sentences.zh: 你度过了非凡的一生，而且你身边环绕着爱你的人。

sentences.en: Several former presidents paid tribute to Carter on Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 周二，几位前总统向卡特致敬。

sentences.en: May God bless you in your final years.
sentences.zh: 愿上帝保佑你安度晚年。

sentences.en: May you have peace of mind and peace in your heart.
sentences.zh: 愿你内心平静，心安理得。

sentences.en: For his part, Carter marked the day in the backyard of his home in Plains, Georgia, where four F-18 fighter jets flew overhead in his honor.
sentences.zh: 卡特本人在佐治亚州平原镇的家中后院度过了这一天，四架F-18战斗机从他头顶飞过，以示敬意。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Stella Tan, Olivia Nat, Will Reed, and Alex Stern, with help from Mouj Zadie.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由斯特拉·谭、奥利维亚·纳特、威尔·里德和亚历克斯·斯特恩制作，穆杰·扎迪提供了帮助。

sentences.en: It was edited by Devin Taylor, contains original music by Dan Powell and Marion Lozano, and was engineered by Chris Wood and Alyssa Moxley.
sentences.zh: 节目由德文·泰勒剪辑，包含丹·鲍威尔和马里昂·洛扎诺的原创音乐，并由克里斯·伍德和艾丽莎·莫克斯利进行工程处理。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brenberg and Ben Lansford of Wonderland.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderland的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰斯福德创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Sabrina Tavernisi.
sentences.zh: 我是萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天，选举迎来了一批自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，该党就陷入了一场伤痕累累、混乱不堪，有时又令人激动的斗争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在《地铁》的最新一集中，我，莎拉·凯尼格，将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro, listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》，在任何你获取播客的地方收听。
